newsitem.title: LATVIA: MANGALI SEES RETURN TO PROFIT, PLANS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: MANGALI SEES RETURN TO PROFIT, PLANS ISSUE.

text.p: Mangali Shipyard shareholders meeting approved a company plan to move back into profit in 1997 and a new public share issue, a shareholder said on Monday.
The meeting on Saturday approved a 1997 plan with forecast earnings of 50,000 lats versus losses of some 12,190 lats in 1996, shareholders said.
Turnover would grow 20 percent to 1.5 million lats from 1.2 million in 1996 but no dividends would be paid in 1997.
The company plans a new public share issue, worth 200,000 lats with a nominal value of one lat.
"When and how is a matter to be decided by the coming meetings," a shareholder told Reuters.
Mangali shareholders' meeting did not decide on boosting its capital as there was no quorum. The issue was postponed until another meeting, to be held within two weeks.
